description: gnvman v1 with the parameters calibrated on WUR AGC4's 2023 pre-trial (decision 0076), as research/validation/agc4/calibrated/tomgro.json reports them and as the test on 2024's fruit ran them. A research result, not the model's published defaults. The pre-trial's cultivar is not verified (the AGC4 memo, §2), so the set names none.
